label: Talking Head
summary: A reusable free-starter Style Pack for creator-led AI-tool/demo reels: the speaker stays visible in the lower half while the upper half renders proof visuals, screenshots, screen recordings, app UI, dashboards, waveforms, prompt cards, recap grids, and CTA plates. Buyers supply their own clips through sourceClips[] and editDecisions[] and proof visuals through mediaSlots[]. v1.3 moves the always-visible proof canvas onto MotionAgent's shared visual vocabulary: the same visual primitives can render full-frame in any pack or split-speaker for talking-head reels.
